releases.notes: 回归套件分层：默认 smoke 只验订阅源管理与结构完整性，断言实时内容（资讯已更新 / 条数 / 来源数）的部分原样搬进 live 套件——上游 RSS 打个嗝就红一次，红灯会失去信号价值。

localizedNotes.en: Split the regression suite: the default smoke suite covers subscription management and structural integrity, while assertions on freshly fetched content move verbatim into a live suite.

releases.notes: 补上正文图片的 CDN 域：36krcdn.com / awtmt.com / 360buyimg.com。此前白名单只列了 RSS 源站（36kr.com、wallstreetcn 等），图片却来自各自独立的图床域，被宿主的图片代理按策略拒掉，表现为缩略图整片加载不出来。注意这是扩权更新，需要手动确认一次。

localizedNotes.en: Adds the article image CDN hosts (36krcdn.com / awtmt.com / 360buyimg.com). The allowlist previously only covered RSS source domains, so thumbnails served from separate image CDNs were blocked. This update expands permissions and requires manual confirmation.

releases.notes: 迁到 TS 构建管线 + @aibox/applet-sdk：桥胶水统一（confirm 不可用一律回 false、openURL 超时封顶、图片走 applet:// 代理），运行形态改为构建型（端上不再转译）。

localizedNotes.en: Migrated to the TS build pipeline and @aibox/applet-sdk; bridge glue unified and the runtime is now prebuilt (no on-device transpile).

releases.notes: 子页栈改用框架资产 aibox/ui 的 useSubpageStack（删除本地 lib/subpages.js 副本）；AI 动作 id 改为下划线式

localizedNotes.en: Subpage stack now uses the framework's useSubpageStack from aibox/ui (local copy removed); AI action ids switched to snake_case

releases.notes: 宿主工具探测改用 aibox.access.explain（tools.describe 在工具不可用时 reject，会在每轮验收里留下一条假故障日志）；新增 .tests.json 回归套件

localizedNotes.en: Probe host tools with aibox.access.explain instead of tools.describe, which rejects when a tool is unavailable and left a false-alarm error in every verification run; add a .tests.json regression suite

releases.notes: 子页导航改用系统原生页栈：详情页左滑返回时实时透出上一页、可中途放弃，不再直接退出整个小应用；顶栏不再与宿主重复画一层；tabs.changed 现在消费 rendered。

localizedNotes.en: Subpages now mirror into the host's native page stack: swiping back reveals the previous page live and can be abandoned mid-drag, instead of dismissing the whole applet. No more duplicated navigation bar, and tabs.changed now consumes rendered.

releases.notes: 修复真机三处核心故障：① 横向分页器轨道被 flex-shrink 压回 1/3 屏宽，导致相邻主题页同屏并排渲染；② 首刷 6 路并发外联触发 6 次授权弹窗，任一次拒绝即锁死整个会话，表现为「永远没有新闻」——改为首次外联单飞，只弹一次；③ 网络被拒/被拦时如实显示「缺少网络访问权限」并给出修法，不再谎报「还没有新闻」。另修：滚动误触打开文章、打开文章无响应无提示、缩略图未走 applet:// 字节通道恒空白。

localizedNotes.en: Fixes three device-blocking bugs: (1) the horizontal pager track was shrunk to 1/3 screen width by flex-shrink, rendering adjacent topic pages side by side; (2) the first refresh fired 6 concurrent network calls and raised 6 consent prompts, where a single decline locked the whole session — the first call is now serialized so only one prompt appears; (3) denied or blocked network now reports 'Network permission missing' with a fix instead of claiming 'No news yet'. Also: scrolling no longer opens articles by accident, a hung article-open now reports failure, and thumbnails route through the applet:// image channel instead of being blocked by CSP.

releases.notes: 首个版本：1:1 复刻原生资讯模块（含 4 个对外 AI 工具）
